subject: Mathematics
title: It is Time
subtitle: Day and night, days of the week, months
hero_picture: A day in a Kerala home from morning to night in one picture: a rooster crowing at sunrise on one side, children at school in the middle, and a moon with an owl at night on the other side.

sections.heading: Morning
text: The rooster crows. It is morning.
Mom woke me up. I brushed my teeth.
Dad gave me dosa and chutney.
sections.caption: A new day begins
sections.picture: Early morning: a rooster crowing on a fence as the sun rises, a mother gently waking a girl in bed.

sections.heading: Mia's diary
text: Mia writes what she does each day.
Morning: school. Noon: lunch. Evening: play.
At night, at 9 o'clock, she goes to sleep.
sections.caption: Mia's day
sections.picture: A girl's morning: brushing her teeth, then eating dosa with chutney at the table with her father; a clock on the wall.

sections.heading: At school
text: Mia drew pictures in her maths notebook.
In the evening she played cricket with friends.
Every part of the day has its work.
sections.caption: School and play
sections.picture: Afternoon at school: children eating lunch together, then playing cricket in the school ground in the evening.

sections.heading: Days of the week
sections.caption: Reading the calendar
sections.picture: A big wall calendar page with seven columns of days and a few dates circled in red, a boy pointing at it (no readable words).

sections.heading: Months and seasons
text: A year has 12 months: January to December.
Summer is hot. Rain comes in the rainy season.
Winter is cool. Spring brings flowers.
sections.caption: Seasons of the year
sections.picture: Four small scenes of seasons in Kerala: a hot dry summer with a hand fan, heavy rain with an umbrella, a misty cold winter morning with a sweater, and spring with flowers.

activity: Write one nice thing you did on each day of this week.
talk: What do you do in the morning?
How many days are there in a week?
Which month is your birthday in?
summary: A day has morning, noon, evening and night; a week has 7 days and a year has 12 months.

questions.prompt: How many days are there in a week?
How many months are there in a year?
In which season do we need an umbrella most?
questions.explanation: It rains a lot in the rainy season.
